name: Riverhead Ciderhouse
reviewNotes:
Added automatically from Out on the Town - Long Island event calendar. Check the name and address; research the dance floor.

Directory research 2026-10-04: riverheadcider.com refuses automated visits (TLS error over https, HTTP 470 over http), so its text was read from a Sept 22, 2026 Internet Archive copy; images came from the site's own WordPress image CDN (i0.wp.com/riverheadcider.com). The old domain riverheadciderhouse.com does not load. ZIP 11933 is from the Out on the Town venue page (2711 Sound Ave, Calverton, 11933), not the venue's own site. No public email found. Only one usable venue photo (the branded truck outside); others on the site are cider/food close-ups, an apple tree, a stock-looking piano shot and a private birthday group. No dance floor is described.
hours: Mon 12 PM-8 PM; closed Tue; Wed 12 PM-8 PM; Thu-Fri 12 PM-9 PM; Sat 11 AM-8 PM; Sun 11 AM-6 PM
description: A hard-cider tasting room on Sound Avenue in Calverton on the North Fork, serving its own New York apple ciders with food, and hosting live music, dueling pianos and trivia nights.

logo.alt: The Riverhead Ciderhouse logo: brown arched lettering over three red apples, with the line New York's Finest Hard Ciders

photos.alt: A vintage red pickup truck with Riverhead Ciderhouse signs, hay bales and pumpkins outside the cider house under a pink sunset sky

evidence.note: Cider house's own home page (Sept 22, 2026 archive copy): tasting room hours, '2711 Sound Ave., Calverton, NY 631-591-0217', Facebook and Instagram links, and a calendar of trivia, dueling pianos and live music.
Out on the Town Long Island event calendar has a venue page for Riverhead Ciderhouse, where its music listings come from.
Business directory lists Riverhead Ciderhouse as a cider bar in Calverton, NY 11933, 631-591-0217.

factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: web.archive.org, outonthetownli.com, chamberofcommerce.com.
